per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall run on any operating system where Java is supported (e.g., Windows, Linux, macOS) and must not assume a single specific OS.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall operate correctly whether the database is local or remote, supporting configurable DB endpoints and robust connection handling.

The application shall provide configurable connection handling (timeouts, retries) and support for schema migration scenarios to tolerate remote DB latencies and avoid failures due to immediate-consistency assumptions.
The application shall be deployable on common Java application servers (e.g., Tomcat, JBoss) without requiring vendor-specific modifications.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The web UI shall render and function in a representative set of browsers (at least eight distinct browsers) and render correctly in approximately 80% of those tests.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The frontend shall avoid relying on bleeding-edge browser features and must transpile/polyfill modern JS/CSS so the UI degrades gracefully on older corporate browsers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The email/notification subsystem shall support configurable SMTP endpoints, authentication methods, TLS versions, and implement sensible retry and backoff behavior with admin alerts on persistent delivery failures.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall target perceived responsiveness such that ~90% of routine tasks complete in under 5 seconds and ~98% complete in under 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall handle approximately 1,000 concurrent requests in the current release and be scalable to handle approximately 2,000 concurrent requests in the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The software shall achieve an availability target of 99.99% (excluding hardware/server-level failures).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: All logins shall be restricted to company employees or externally approved users with vetted company IDs; anonymous or unapproved accounts are prohibited.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with applicable accessibility laws and standards (e.g., screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, sufficient color contrast).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product shall avoid requiring exotic platform components and should prefer widely used/open-source stacks so it can co-exist with typical enterprise server software.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI/booking workflows shall be designed for simplicity and efficiency, aiming for common actions to be doable in one click where reasonable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement monitoring and alerting so admins are notified of persistent failures (e.g., repeated email delivery failures or outages) to ensure operational visibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'
